meta.name: Offer and confirm technician visit slots with Google Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, and Telegram

name: Book the visit: offer three free slots from a technician calendar and confirm in one click

parameters.content:
## Book the visit: offer three free slots from a technician calendar and confirm in one click

### How it works

This workflow automates technician visit booking by accepting a job request, checking a Google Calendar for availability, and emailing the customer three available time slots with one-click confirmation links. When the customer chooses a slot, it verifies the offer is still open, creates the appointment, updates the tracking sheet, and sends confirmation. A daily scheduled sweep sends visit reminders and expires stale offers back to dispatch for manual follow-up.

### Setup steps

- Create a sheet named Bookings with these headers in row 1: booking_id, created_at, customer_name, email, phone, job_type, job_summary, duration_min, status, booked_start, booked_end, event_id, reminder_sent.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and point all five sheet nodes at that document and sheet.
- In Update Sheet as Booked, Log Sent Reminder and Mark Sheet as Expired, select booking_id under Column to Match On. This field resets whenever the document is re-selected and the node fails without it.
- Connect Google Calendar credentials and set the technician calendar in both calendar nodes, or use primary while testing.
- Set BASE_URL in Draft Offer Email to your own n8n domain, with no trailing slash, so the buttons in the email point back at the second webhook.
- Connect Gmail and Telegram credentials, and set the chat ID in both dispatch alerts.
- Post a job to the first webhook with customer_name, email, phone, job_type and job_summary.

### Customization

Job types match the AI enquiry triage template, so the two chain together. Change DURATIONS_MIN to fit your own trades, or PREFERRED_WINDOWS to offer mornings only. Working hours, travel buffer and minimum notice all live in the CONFIG block of Find Available Slots. Daylight saving is read from the timezone name rather than a fixed offset, so a spring booking made in winter still lands at the right hour.

## Receive booking request

Accepts the initial job booking webhook, immediately acknowledges receipt, and normalizes the enquiry into a structured booking request.

## Find available slots

Reads technician calendar busy times, computes up to three free appointment options, and branches based on whether any valid slots were found.

## Email slot offer

Builds the HTML offer message and sends the customer the available time slots with one-click selection links.

## Log offered slots

Formats the offer data for the tracking sheet and records the pending booking offer for later confirmation or expiry handling.

## Alert no availability

Notifies dispatch through Telegram when the automated search cannot find suitable free technician slots.

## Receive slot choice

Handles the customer's slot-selection webhook, parses the clicked booking ID and start time, and retrieves the stored booking row.

## Validate selection status

Checks whether the booking offer is still open and shows an already-handled response if the choice is stale, duplicate, or no longer valid.

## Create confirmed appointment

Builds the calendar event from the selected slot, creates the appointment in Google Calendar, and returns the confirmation page to the customer.

## Record booking confirmation

Updates the booking log as booked and sends the customer a final confirmation email.

## Run daily booking sweep

Starts each morning, loads all booking rows, determines which records need reminders or expiry actions, and routes each action type.

## Send visit reminders

Emails reminders for upcoming booked visits and stamps the sheet so each reminder is only sent once.

## Expire stale offers

Hands unaccepted or stale offers back to dispatch through Telegram and marks those booking rows as expired in the sheet.
